title: fix(console): pin the view settings draft save to the draft it opened, so Save to this view never publishes it (#36137)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XURgXCZHcjPoyo5g9cMEATi)_

Fixes #36137

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `ViewConfigPanel`'s `onSave` host prop gains an optional second parameter, the panel's draft-version guard (`saveDraft`), which the panel always passes; a host that takes one argument is called as before; nothing removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在视图设置里保存时，若另一位管理员正好在「保存到这个视图」，这次保存会被拒绝，并弹出“草稿已被改动”的提示，可选重新加载、覆盖或继续编辑；平时保存无感。新建视图时若同名视图已有未发布的修改，也会被拒绝，而不是盖掉它。
- 属于共享视图「确认后立即对所有人生效」那件事的收尾：保证一个人的未发布修改不会被另一个人的保存顺带发布。
- 出错时最多是管理员偶尔多看到一次冲突提示、需要重新加载或确认覆盖；可直接撤回本改动，恢复原来的保存方式。
- 无。

Route: direction B of the card, client-only (area claim 7073591363). No `/meta` door, server or `packages/spec` change.

## What changes

**The view settings panel's draft save is pinned** (`ViewConfigPanel`, `handleViewConfigSave`, `persistRuntimeMetadata`)

- The panel's load already reads the stored view (`layered`) and the served draft. The draft read is now `MetadataClient.getDraft`, the envelope, so its `version` pins the buffer's saves through the Studio editors' guard (`useDraftSaveGuard`, `draftPinOf`): `If-Match` with the version the load read, `If-None-Match: *` when the view had no draft. A save that lands holds its receipt's version for the next one. Read and save both name no package, the address the server resolves the same way for both.
- The panel hands its guard to the host as `onSave`'s second argument; `handleViewConfigSave` passes it to `persistRuntimeMetadata`, which writes through it when given (a report's save still goes unpinned, untouched).
- A `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` opens the guard's dialog (`DraftConflictDialog`, its existing `engine.draftConflict.*` text: "This draft changed since you opened it … saved elsewhere — by someone else or in another tab"): **Reload saved version** re-reads the stored view into the panel and refreshes the host's list (the path a draft-bar publish or discard takes); **Overwrite…** re-sends pinned to the refusal's `currentVersion` after a second confirmation; **Keep editing** saves nothing, keeps the edit in the panel and Save live, and says "Not saved" through the host's existing refusal toast.
- A draft-bar Publish or Discard re-reads the view (as before), so the next save is pinned to "no draft" again.

**A view create carries the first-write pin** (`createRuntimeMetadata`)

- `{ mode: 'draft', ifNoneMatch: '*' }` (with the app's package when there is one): a create over a name that already holds a pending draft is refused instead of written over it. Same function for the runtime report / dashboard / page creates, which take the same pin.

**Docs**: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`, the Save to this view bullet, one sentence. Changeset `36137-pinned-view-draft-writes.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

- New `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx`, against a `fetch` double of the `/meta` view doors with the real `MetadataClient` and the real panel:
  - the card's interleave: Save to this view's pinned draft write lands, its publish is parked; a settings save then goes out `If-None-Match: *`, is refused 409 and opens the dialog, and the Save's draft is untouched; the publish then publishes exactly the Save's body. Keep editing leaves the edit on screen and Save live, with nothing written;
  - the same interleave, then Reload: nothing written, the panel holds the published view, and its next save goes `If-None-Match: *` and lands;
  - over no draft: the first save `If-None-Match: *`, the next `If-Match` on the first receipt's version;
  - over its own loaded draft: `If-Match` on the version the load read;
  - a create over a name holding a pending draft is refused 409 with `If-None-Match: *` and the draft is unchanged; a create of a new name lands (control).
- `ObjectView.viewConfigSaveWiring-10210.test.tsx` (+1 describe): `ObjectView`'s handler writes through the guard the panel hands it, never straight to the client.
- Updated to the pinned create options (`ifNoneMatch: '*'`), same assertion otherwise: `runtime-metadata-persistence.test.ts` (2), `runtime-metadata-persistence.otherTypesUntouched-35624.test.ts`, `ObjectView.createChartView-11576.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.createKanbanView-11581.test.tsx`; `ViewConfigPanel.resumeEnvelope-10210.test.tsx`'s client serves the draft read through `getDraft`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Every Console writer of a view draft, measured at the merge base** (`git grep "mode: 'draft'"` under `ui/packages`, cited by symbol):
  - view settings save, `handleViewConfigSave` → `persistRuntimeMetadata`: was unpinned, pinned here;
  - view create, `createRuntimeMetadata` (`handleViewCreate`, `ObjectDataPage`'s Save as view): was unpinned, pinned here;
  - Save to this view, `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`: already `If-None-Match: *`;
  - Studio writers (`ObjectListViewInspector`, `useFormViewDraft`, `ResourceEditPage`, `StudioBundleItemEditor`, `StudioDesignSurface`'s creates and leaf drafts): already through `useDraftSaveGuard` or the first-write pin;
  - the footer calculation: no longer a server writer since it became a part of the list draft, so nothing to pin;
  - `ObjectStackAdapter.updateView`'s draft half (rename, pin, set as default on a view with a pending draft): unpinned, **not changed here**. It reads the draft and writes it back in one call, so both requests can fall inside the window; a pin on its own read would carry the Save's draft version and pass. Only a publish precondition (the card's direction A) closes it. Named in the report for the area to route.
- The card's second acceptance line: no docs or changeset text in the tree carries the "known edge" note (`git grep -i "known edge"` and the card number: zero hits outside an unrelated ADR's "Known edges" heading); it lives only in the merged PR #36123's body, which is landed history and not edited here.
- `DraftConflictDialog`'s module header says a draft read naming no package serves `version: null` for a package-bound draft; the server's `readVersionToken` now serves the token of the draft a package-less save overwrites. Both of this panel's requests name no package, so they agree either way. Not changed.

## Verification

Head at open: `f86ba5fc`. Final head `a383241b` (one commit after it: the new test's mock signature, which the `f86ba5fc` type-check named); CI on `a383241b`: every check-run success or skipped.

<details><summary>Local runs (under the shared verification lock)</summary>

- At `7f297043`, after the `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency closure was built (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, exit 0): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `app-shell/src/views/` `ViewConfigPanel*`, `ObjectView*`, `runtime-metadata*`, `objectViewViewCrud*`, `metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog*`, `ObjectDataPage*`, `CreateViewDialog*`, `RuntimeDraftBar*`, `ReportView*`, `viewCacheInvalidation*`: Test Files 141 passed, 1 failed (142); Tests 1288 passed, 1 failed (1289). The new file passed. The one failure was `runtime-metadata-persistence.pendingDraftsPulse-13139.test.tsx` expecting `persistRuntimeMetadata` to resolve `undefined`; it now resolves the outcome, and the pin reads `'saved'` (same assertion otherwise). `pnpm run type-check` (app-shell, both programs): one error, `ViewConfigPanel.onSaveHosts-11583.test.ts` calling a host with one argument; fixed in the declaration (the guard parameter is optional), not in the pin. Both fixes are in `f86ba5fc`; the re-run on it is in the report.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` over this diff: every family exit 0, except three that did not finish inside a 240 s local window (`check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-debt`; CI runs them) and `check:skill-examples`, which refused on a prerequisite (exit 3, nothing measured; this diff touches no skill). `check:test-source-alias` first named the wiring test (it reaches a dynamic `@objectstack/lint` import); fixed with a module-top import, then exit 0. `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 0 once `@objectstack/lint` was built.
- eslint on the five changed `ui/` source and test files: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` `4ab12189`.

</details>

**Read first**: `ViewConfigPanel.tsx` (the load's pin and the guard's reload), `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` (`persistRuntimeMetadata`'s `'reloaded'` path writes and announces nothing), `ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx`.

**Two-minute check**: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.pinnedDraftSave-36137.test.tsx` — 6 tests pass (the first is the card's interleave: the settings save is refused 409 and the publish carries only the Save's body).
